dbtCommander.venvPath.description: Path to the Python virtual environment that has dbt-core 1.x installed (the folder containing Scripts\dbt.exe).

dbtCommander.extraArgs.description: Extra flags appended to every dbt command except deps, separated by spaces (quotes keep values together).

dbtCommander.previewLimit.description: Maximum number of rows returned by dbt Preview Data (dbt show --limit).

dbtCommander.codeLens.description: Show Run · Build · Test · Compile · Preview links above each dbt model.

dbtCommander.openDocsAfterGenerate.description: Open the static docs page in your browser after dbt docs generate.

dbtCommander.notifyAfterSeconds.description: Show a notification with the results when a dbt command takes at least this many seconds (0 = never).

dbtCommander.newModelTemplate.description: Optional template file for "dbt New model…" (relative to the dbt project or absolute). {{name}} is replaced with the model name.

enumDescriptions: No SQLFluff features at all; SQLFluff is never started.
Lint dbt SQL files with the SQLFluff in the dbt venv; warn if it is not installed.
Lint when the dbt venv has SQLFluff; stay silent otherwise.
dbtCommander.sqlfluff.enabled.description: SQLFluff linting of dbt SQL files (problems on open / save, Format Document, fix on save). Off by default.

dbtCommander.sqlfluff.fixOnSave.description: When SQLFluff linting is on: run `sqlfluff fix` on manual saves (one undo step). Auto-saves are left alone.

dbtCommander.sqlfluff.dialect.description: SQLFluff dialect (e.g. tsql). Empty: the project's SQLFluff config, else the dbt adapter's dialect.

dbtCommander.sqlfluff.extraArgs.description: Extra flags for every SQLFluff run, e.g. `--rules LT01,LT02` or `--templater dbt`.

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.datetimePatte.description: Create staging model: columns whose name matches this regex (case-sensitive) are typed DATETIME2.

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.datePattern.description: Create staging model: columns whose name matches this regex (case-sensitive) are typed DATE.

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.keyColumn.description: Create staging model: the key column (any case). It is kept and also copied to the key alias; empty = no key.

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.keyAlias.description: Create staging model: name of the copy of the key column.

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.partitionColu.description: Create staging model: dedupe partition columns before the key (or before every column not starting with _ when the table has no key).

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.orderColumns.description: Create staging model: dedupe keeps the newest row by these columns (descending).

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.deleteColumn.description: Create staging model: delete-flag column; empty = no delete filter.

dbtCommander.bronzeStaging.deleteKeepVal.description: Create staging model: rows are kept when LOWER(delete column) is one of these.

dbtCommander.scd2.historySchema.description: SCD2 change-key model: schema of the history table (passed to generate_schema_name).

dbtCommander.scd2.historyPrefix.description: SCD2 change-key model: history table name prefix (<prefix><source>__<entity>__history).

dbtCommander.scd2.changeKeyFolder.description: SCD2 change-key model: folder for int_<source>__<entity>__changekey.sql (relative to the project).

dbtCommander.scd2.hashColumns.description: SCD2 change-key model: the first of these the staging model has is used as attribute_hash; with none, the hash_columns macro hashes the data columns.

dbtCommander.scd2.extractDateColumn.description: SCD2 change-key model: the staging model's extract date, matched against the history table's valid_from.

dbtCommander.scd2.generatedFolder.description: SCD2: folder for the dim_<source>__<entity>__candidate / __history / __published models created with the change-key model (relative to the project).

dbtCommander.scd2.testsFolder.description: SCD2: folder for the dim_<source>__<entity>__gates singular test (calls scd2_gate_test), relative to the project.

dbtCommander.scd2.varsFile.description: SCD2: the vars file (relative to the project) whose scd2_dimensions: list gets each new dimension's entry.

dbtCommander.autoParse.description: Run dbt parse in the background when files dbt reads change (models, YAML, seeds, snapshots, macros, tests, dbt_project.yml), so the sidebar, lineage and completion stay current. Waits for other dbt commands; a failure shows in the status bar.
